title: Ampleness is invariant under Noetherian nilpotent thickenings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Sections giving affine opens on the reduced closed subscheme need not lift, and the proof must remove the H1 obstruction. After reduction to square-zero ideals, the connecting map is treated as a derivation, so powers of a section kill its obstruction and produce affine principal opens on the thickening.
